title: FlowDoc Core Backend Editor Readiness Pass 8h
summary: Execute an eight-hour bounded readiness pass before deeper Editor/frontend implementation, starting by reconciling Core fixture state, proving the Backend owner gate against the actual sibling Core checkout, adding bounded Editor live Backend rich-inline harness evidence, defining the Editor text-block authoring boundary, adding memory-only active text-block island runtime state, wiring that state into the Editor Backend mutation lifecycle, adding an Editor-owned active text-block island commit runner with live Backend proof, adding an Editor-owned node placement readiness matrix, adding an Editor-owned add-node contract builder before visible typing UI, adding the Backend active add-node mutation transport gate with Editor capability parser compatibility, adding the Editor add-node activation harness for active insert contracts behind Backend capability and revision gates, activating the bounded visible Outline add-node UI for Text/Columns insert operations through the same Backend capability and revision gates, adding a bounded visible text-block textarea island that saves the first text inline run through Backend rich-inline mutation and reload proof, and hardening that text-block editing UX with Core v4 line-break normalization, dirty-state cleanup, save-rejection recovery, multiline rows, and live Backend reload evidence, and extending Editor text-bearing node coverage so the Outline exposes nested text-block descendants inside columns/table surfaces and opens a bounded textarea for selected nested text through live Backend save/reload evidence.
expectedOutput: A phased readiness pass that records exact Core, Backend, and Editor evidence before frontend implementation continues. The first completed slice restores the missing Core PDF fixture working-tree state with explicit user approval, verifies Core and Backend owner gates, and keeps broad product readiness unpromoted. The second completed slice records Editor commit 3b592b48765337efdbd6da539130d2daae1349bc as a bounded live Backend rich-inline harness only. The third completed slice records Editor commit e67a67f8c7dfa703ada43428a366d0db56bd4393 as the tested text-block authoring boundary without enabling active text input. The fourth completed slice records Editor commit 24219dc0d6e5ec79368c82b159b37e3f9a0b9ed5 as tested memory-only active text-block island runtime state without visible canvas input binding. The fifth completed slice records Editor commit 7dc118a23a993c5fb7ca6168ee77027dc9324cfa as the tested active text-block island Backend lifecycle integration inside Editor runtime. The sixth completed slice records Editor commit 747a7269838d457b940251be33cd275d80f9c3b4 as the active text-block island commit runner with focused tests and live loopback Backend proof. The seventh completed slice records Editor commit 2be3145210eac74ecc6b82d547f6471456b36114 as the node placement readiness matrix that mirrors Core allowed child types and computes sibling, inside, and append placement facts without enabling add-node transport or WYSIWYG behavior. The eighth completed slice records Editor commit d2290b47a37adc8aee2067ed4e094c6f39350b6c as the add-node contract builder that creates text-block.insert and columns.insert contract requests from ready placements while keeping Backend add-node transport activation blocked. The ninth completed slice records Backend commit fd6bd6a2c35c2f0bc7a0245b17beadf86ce39e08 as the active add-node mutation transport gate for columns.insert and text-block.insert, plus Editor commit 623d91f204803cb9ac8d7ab7a71246326b77ef78 as rollout-safe capability parser compatibility, without enabling visible add-node UI, WYSIWYG behavior, or document v4 insert semantics. The tenth completed slice records Editor commit ae6978e3646e6ac4bbedc6ec15e6e38343bf0585 as the bounded add-node activation harness that types Editor BackendMutationOperation inserts, gates ready add-node contracts against Backend mutationOperations for the current active package/document pair, runs columns.insert and text-block.insert through a live local Backend server, and applies returned mutation read envelopes into Editor runtime state without visible UI activation. The eleventh completed slice records Editor commit 10ee27089114400468a2faa586997b1bcb15abc9 as the bounded visible Outline add-node UI that renders Text/Columns add controls from ready contracts, commits text-block.insert and columns.insert through live Backend via browser clicks, reloads, upgrades, and reorders afterward, and still keeps WYSIWYG behavior, active typing, unsupported node kinds, and document v4 insert semantics closed. The twelfth completed slice records Editor commit 6f59f7269322abfe3428d4df6f4ba0ee6ab0078f as the bounded visible text-block textarea island that edits only the first text inline run of a selected package 3/document 4 text-block, commits through text-block.rich-inline.replace by explicit Save/Ctrl+Enter, reloads the saved text from Backend api r7, and keeps contenteditable, WYSIWYG, multi-run rich-inline editing, field-chip editing, durable drafts, and broad frontend readiness closed. The thirteenth completed slice records Editor commit a42409a31cb855331e5114a52bc3d07d75cb67e6 as bounded text-block editing UX hardening: textarea CR/LF becomes Core document v4 line-break inline atomics, dirty state clears when the draft returns to the Backend value, rejected save state clears after the next edit, multiline textarea rows are bounded and visible, and live Backend browser smoke proves multiline save and reload without enabling WYSIWYG, contenteditable, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, or broad frontend readiness. Project Control commit 0e0c5fd617ac4618a4a03066a0dd719ce658380c also keeps Work phaseIds ordered by phase.order so this multi-phase Work remains readable in overview consumers. The fourteenth completed slice records Editor commit 3cc2cf9e008fa43bd0be491f4dc6ba83b041faf2 as bounded text-bearing node coverage: Outline exposes editable text-block descendants under columns/table surfaces, Outline selection preserves exact nested text-block targets while canvas and structural commands remain surface-based, Backend text-block.rich-inline.replace apply preserves nested text selection after save, PaperBlock renders a bounded embedded textarea for the selected nested text descendant, and live Backend browser smoke proves summary-left-text save/reload before continuing to reorder, without enabling WYSIWYG, contenteditable, exact cell/column layout authoring, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, field-ref editing, or broad frontend readiness.
riskSummary: This Work record is an execution thread, not product truth. It does not promote FlowDoc, Core, Backend, or Editor readiness; production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, performance, accessibility, visual regression, complete text-block authoring UX, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, durable draft persistence, and full frontend redesign remain unresolved until separately verified. The visible text-block typing and text-block editing UX slices are bounded to selected package 3/document 4 text-blocks with a first editable text/line-break inline range; the text-bearing node coverage slice extends that same bounded textarea path to text-block descendants represented inside columns/table surfaces when selected from Outline, but does not provide exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, field-ref chip editing, arbitrary rich-inline ranges as a full authoring surface, or generic WYSIWYG content. The text-block editing UX slice preserves trailing field refs but does not prove leading empty-line identity behavior, IME composition beyond existing hook coverage, clipboard semantics, very large document performance, accessibility readiness, collaboration, durable drafts, or export parity. The Backend add-node transport gate, Editor add-node activation harness, and bounded visible Outline add-node UI are bounded to active package 2/document 3 columns.insert and text-block.insert. Document v4 insert semantics remain explicitly unsupported by Backend until Core document v4 exposes insert operations, and the Editor harness blocks missing capability support for the current package/document pair before commitMutation. The bounded visible UI exposes only Text and Columns actions from the Outline panel and does not enable generic table, toc, page-break, divider, spacer, table row, or table column add paths; those remain blocked or unmodeled until repository-owned Core/Backend/UI contracts are separately verified.
